product.summary: Satochip smart-card hardware wallet using an EAL6+ secure element and current desktop/mobile integrations.
product.notes: Current first-party product page offers Satochip for purchase and states private keys cannot be extracted from the secure chip. Support status remains conservative `unknown` rather than inferring a formal maintenance commitment from current documentation alone.

evidence.notes: Current first-party product page offers Satochip for sale and states private keys are handled inside an EAL6+ secure element and cannot be extracted from the chip.
